notes.title: Extra XP from Customer Reviews and Online Orders
notes.notes:
[h1]1- Extra XP from Customer Reviews[/h1][p]100% increase![/p][p]As you know, you get extra level points if you complete a day with more than 4 points.[/p][p]Here are the updated numbers:[/p][list][*][p][i]If your review score is 4.00, you get 20 level points instead of 10 level points.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]If you're above 4.00, you get more level points (20+). The higher the review score, the higher the level points.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]If your review score is 5.00, you get 50 level points instead of 25 level points.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]You can see how many level points you earn in the daily report.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/86265b9b86a686e54cf7c96a216c9e11dd1838ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As a reminder:[/p][p]You can check your current score from the Desktop-Customer Reviews.[/p][p][u]How to increase customer satisfaction?[/u][/p][p]* Avoid long checkout queues

* Let your customers find all products in the store racks
* Place some decorations to provide a beautiful atmosphere
* Place some speakers and let your customers listen to some relaxing music in your store[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/7d82475d6e6b5ee36499dd90567e21eb2281821d.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]2- Extra XP from Online Orders[/h1][p]Each completed online order brings 20 level points instead of 15.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b140d2f66cd148f8995b12558ef6ed404ce879a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]3- Business Tycoon is removed from the shopping bags[/h1][p]Now there is nothing written on the shopping bags, but your store logo is still there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/fb068b71ddc558a0c00c9e8a3097a3c59ffe7cf6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2]Sporting Goods Shop is now available in Early Access![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3653250/Sporting_Goods_Shop/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Full Release Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Version 1.0 is out now![/p][p]First of all, I would like to thank the awesome community. Thank you so much for your ideas, suggestions, and feedback. It helped me a lot in this journey :)[/p][previewyoutube="hYNHMx9mBWQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][u]Your save files are fine![/u][/h3][p]Your current save files are fully compatible with the full version.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a974fd32088faa09d354d89fe548954b439d654a.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h3][u]Here are the new features and content in v1.0[/u][/h3][h1]1- Cigarette Vending Machine[/h1][p]As you can see, there is a cigarette vending machine in front of the store.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/007bf667a67284469dd968f0e3d3fefa1f9a5114.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can purchase it in the Desktop-Cigarette Vending Machine section when you reach the required store level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/37dbb11572a4fd5096d60589820350191651ebf5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u]This machine is active day and night.[/u][/p][list][*][p][i]Day Time Sales:[/i] You get the money immediately if any cigarette is sold during the day.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][i]Night Time Sales:[/i] You get the money from the night sales in the early morning. Night sales depend on how many different product types you provide in the vending machine. In other words, more product types, more income.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/1f3ef827f63c53a1d06788ba14751b97e2e1bd36.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]You get a notification on the left side of the screen showing you the previous night's sales.[/i][/p][p][i]No level points are coming from the cigarette vending machine.[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]2- Discount Event[/h1][p]When you set a discount event, it'll start the next day and last a day. You can use the object snapping feature while placing store racks, warehouse racks, decorations, cash registers, and speakers.
[i](You can disable it in the Options - Gameplay settings.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/e741525ad2256136358754f6e9d8a5350d73dfa9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2b7e7c7cbffbe209363bac049334372571477ecd.jpg[/img]

* Avoid long checkout queues
* Keep the store clean
* Set product prices by considering the recommended prices
* Let your customers find all products in the store racks
* Place some decorations to provide a beautiful atmosphere
* Place some speakers and let your customers listen to some relaxing music in your store
